look_here_first: Expect an intermediate ironweed. Plants occur where western ironweed and woolly ironweed meet, with foliage, hairiness, leaf width, and head characters falling between the parents.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Asteraceae head made entirely of purple disc florets; no ray florets.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: perennial ironweed; purple discoid flower heads; intermediate leaf width and hairiness; intermediate between V. baldwinii and V. lindheimeri; often found where parent habitats meet; mature flowering material and nearby parents are important for confident ID

key_traits.label: Comparison training
key_traits.text: Do not force intermediate ironweeds into one parent. V. lindheimeri has narrow strongly revolute leaves with dense white hairs beneath; V. baldwinii has broader less-woolly foliage. The hybrid spans the middle.
